provider_receipt.summary: Read-only review completed; no project files were modified and the parent clean-tree verification receipt is valid. Defects: (1) src/lib.rs:56-89 implements MemoryStore::store as a no-op that serializes and discards each MemoryRecord, so the advertised Mnemosyne persistence never occurs and annunimas-mnemosyne is unused. (2) src/lib.rs:13-25 and 152-163 use a legacy frontmatter schema incompatible with docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:71-93, notably requiring numeric confidence while the active contract specifies low|medium|high and omitting authority, privacy, provenance, and review fields; contract-conforming notes therefore fail ingestion or lose required classification. (3) src/lib.rs:106-129 treats every Markdown file as trusted semantic human memory without enforcing status, authority, privacy, quarantine, provenance, or review requirements, contrary to docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:23-25 and 96-123; one malformed or unrelated Markdown file also aborts the entire scan. (4) src/lib.rs:167-192 accepts absolute paths and parent traversal in wikilinks, does not canonicalize or enforce vault containment, and exposes existing out-of-vault paths through HumanNote.backlinks. Existing tests cover only legacy happy paths and missing-vault rejection; they do not cover persistence, the documented contract, privacy/authority handling, malformed-note isolation, or path traversal.
